blocks.text: You can connect your Sentry organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Manager or Owner privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your Sentry organization.
To connect your Sentry organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Sentry.
In the Add Integration window, click Add.

blocks.text: A consent window appears, where you can see a detailed list of permissions and data.
If you are integrating Zscaler SaaS Security with Sentry for the first time, the consent window appears, else the integration continues without displaying the consent window.
Your Sentry organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
